dialogue_texts: Ah... ahahaha! Splendid! Truly, the power of your gavel is nothing short of breathtaking.
Save the applause. You're completely wide open now.
Are you ready to explain your little parallel experiment, or do I need to throw you in prison?
Let us see if your light can pierce the eternal shroud!
Hey! Did you even hear a word I just said? Stop resetting the conversation and answer me!
Heh... You think you've won just because you cleared my danmaku?
The Order's roots run deeper than this cemetery, shrine maiden.
Ugh, every single villain in this place speaks in the same cryptic riddles.
I'm going back to enjoy the festival. If the world ends, someone wake me up.
